title.en: An Act Declaring March 7 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Island Garden City of Samal, Province of Davao Del Norte, in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 7 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Island Garden City of Samal, Province of Davao Del Norte, in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 7 tháng 3 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Thành phố Vườn Đảo Samal, Tỉnh Davao Del Norte, nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 7 มีนาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในเมืองสวนเกาะ Samal จังหวัด Davao Del Norte เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 7 Maret setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Kota Taman Pulau Samal, Provinsi Davao Del Norte, dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 7 Mac setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Bandar Taman Pulau Samal, Wilayah Davao Del Norte, sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12246_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: March 7 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Island Garden City of Samal, Province of Davao del Norte, in commemoration of its foundation day. Upon proclamation of the President, March 7 of every year shall be a special non-working holiday in the said city.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
